basics.name: Robin Vega
basics.label: Head of AI — Computer Vision & Real-Time Perception
basics.summary: Computer-vision lead. I own the path from dataset to a model running in real time on the box, and I build the evaluation harness that proves it works.

work.name: Northwind Perception GmbH
highlights: Drive the AI roadmap so computer-vision initiatives line up with product goals and real field feedback.
Built an evaluation pipeline that feeds real recordings through the production system end to end and scores the output with a custom metrics engine, measuring exactly what the user sees.
Own AI-related feedback from the field and from other departments, turning it into concrete improvements to models, data and evaluation.
Unified the AI architecture across products — cutting duplicated inference code and shortening deployment cycles
Defined CI/CD and Python standards across the team — `uv`, `ruff` and GitHub Actions — so every repo lints, tests and ships the same way.

work.name: Northwind Perception GmbH
highlights: Improved multi-object-tracking quality through analytical Kalman filter tuning and automated hyper-parameter search — +20% HOTA and +32% association accuracy, with 26% fewer false positives and 25% fewer ID switches
Cut false positives 12x by making a visual dataset-curation tool a core part of the team's data workflow.
Raised inference throughput on NVIDIA Jetson by fusing pre-processing into the model graph with PyTorch hooks and exporting to TensorRT.
Built a YOLO-based end-to-end horizon detection model that runs in real time with almost no post-processing.
Extended the YOLO training pipeline with thermal-specific augmentations to generalise across LWIR camera models.
